articles.summary: - Twelve academic and private clinical sites across the U.S. broaden patient access to the pivotal trial as Femasys advances FemBloc toward potential FDA approval - ATLANTA, Oct. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Femasys Inc. (NASDAQ: FEMY), a leading biomedical innovator developing transformative fertility and non-surgical permanent birth control solutions designed to improve the standard of care, expand access, and reduce costs for women worldwide, announced today that it has doubled the number of actively enrolling sites in its FemBloc ® FINALE Pivotal Trial to twelve across the United States. The coast-to-coast network of academic centers and private clinical practices now includes Baylor Research Institute and Columbia University Medical Center, joining existing academic sites Maimonides Medical Center, Stanford University, University of California Davis and the University of Utah. articles.summary: First in a planned network of specialty pharmacy partnerships provides medication coordination and preferred pricing for OB/GYNs and their patients ATLANTA, Oct. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Femasys Inc. (NASDAQ: FEMY), a leading biomedical innovator developing transformative fertility and non-surgical permanent birth control solutions designed to improve the standard of care, expand access, and reduce costs for women worldwide, announced today an agreement with SandsRx Pharmacy , marking the first in a planned network of specialty pharmacy partnerships supporting the launch of FemaSeed and Femasys’ comprehensive fertility portfolio to OB/GYN practices. The partnership complements a portfolio spanning diagnostics for women and men, sperm preparation and in-office fertility treatment by providing specialized pharmacy support, coordinated medication access and preferred pricing. articles.summary: ATLANTA, Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Femasys Inc. (NASDAQ: FEMY), a leading biomedical innovator developing transformative fertility and non-surgical permanent birth control solutions designed to improve the standard of care, expand access, and reduce costs for women worldwide, announced today the appointment of John Moorhead to its Board of Directors as a board designee in connection with the Company’s August 2026 private placement. Mr. Moorhead brings more than two decades of experience in consumer marketing, brand development, product innovation and finance. He spent 12 years at Unilever’s Seventh Generation, where he rose to Chief Marketing Officer and helped transform the brand into a household name while more than quadrupling its Home Care business.
